rows.note: This is the all-purpose, neutral way to say a female romantic partner.

example.english: My girlfriend's birthday is tomorrow, so I plan to have dinner with her.
example.traditional: 我女朋友聽日生日，我諗住同佢食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 teng1 jat6 saang1 jat6 ngo5 nam2 zyu6 tung4 keoi5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial term in casual speech when referring informally to your or someone else's girlfriend.

example.english: His girlfriend says she isn't free tonight.
example.jyutping: keoi5 tiu4 neoi5 waa6 gam1 maan5 m4 dak1 haan4
